exposure: Maternal perception of quantity of breast milk
cohort: 2640 mothers who gave birth to healthy term infants in Fars, Iran, between April 2012 and October 2014
finding: The most important factors affecting EBF duration were infant's weight gain during EBF, singleton/multiple pregnancies, maternal perception of quantity of breast milk, post-partum infection, use of pacifier, neonate's irritability, birth place, and mother's full-time job.
